chunks: That when Abū Jaʿfar al-Bāqir عليه السلام passed away, Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام continued to order that a lamp be kept in the house in which he had lived, until Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام passed away. Then Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام ordered the like of that in the house of Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام until he was taken with it to Iraq; then it is not known what became of it.

key_terms.أُخْرِجَ: he was taken out or removed
key_terms.السِّرَاجِ: the lamp that was ordered to be kept lit
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the house or residence in which the Imam had lived
key_terms.الْعِرَاقِ: Iraq, the place to which he was taken
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: What does this narration say about keeping a lamp lit in the house of the deceased Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This report describes the continued lighting of a lamp in the residence of Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام after his passing, as maintained by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام. It also records that Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام continued the same practice in the house of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام until he was taken to Iraq.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.447 - It has been narrated that when Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) passed away, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) continued to have a lamp lit in the room where Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) lived, until Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) also passed away.

Then Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) also instructed to do the same in the room of Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) to remain lit until He was taken to Iraq, after which it is unknown what happened”.
